title: 第44章 建军节

第44章 建军节-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

下一章

中午在食堂吃饭的时候，碰到好多熟人。卫生队的周队长、政治处的刘干事、后勤处的王处长，还有几个这几天认识的其他部门的干事，都端着饭盆过来跟他打招呼，对他表示祝贺。

王副团长最热闹，端着饭盆从另一张桌子走过来，重重地拍了一下王建新的肩膀，差点把他拍趴下。王副团长的大嗓门在食堂里嗡嗡响：“好好干！去了学校，认真学习，有啥事给我打电话。记住，咱们团是你的娘家！”

王建新不知道王团长的手疼不疼？赶紧站正敬礼：“是，首长！”

王副团长满意地点了点头，端着饭盆走了。王建新能看见王团长的那个手在来回的转拳，应该挺疼的吧？毕竟他的肉身可是能扛子弹的。

时间过得很快。王建新不停地学习，白天看西医书籍，晚上看俄语医学资料，后半夜进空间修炼。现在他对西医理论学得个八九不离十了——解剖、生理、病理、药理、诊断，各门功课都啃了一遍。他脑子好使，看一遍就记住了，理解得也快。只需要到了学校学习实操，他就会飞快地进步，用不了多长时间，他的西医医术便能达到大成。

晚上简单在食堂吃了点，便早早回到宿舍继续学习。最近后半夜他经常去空间改善伙食。部队虽然能吃饱，粗粮管饱，一个月能见着一两次肉，但官兵们还是很辛苦的，每天训练量大，消耗多，营养跟不上。

在空间里，除了改善伙食——炖羊肉、煎牛排、炒鸡蛋、各种鱼子酱、海鲜、松露，换着花样吃。白面馒头和大米饭管够——最烦人的便是挤牛奶、做奶制品，这个很费时间，还好空间的时间比变化了。他还努力地修炼着。炼气四层就这么牛，要是达到五层、六层，那又会是什么样？他不敢想，但心里痒痒的。每天盘腿坐在河边，灵气在体内运转，液态灵力在丹田里缓缓流动，像一池春水。炼气四层到五层，还有很长的路要走，但他不急，慢慢来。

第二天，八月一日，建军节。

全团都早早起来。天还没亮透，操场上就热闹开了。布置会场的布置会场，插红旗的插红旗，战士们跑进跑出，忙得脚不沾地。全团都在训练场上忙活着——打扫卫生的把操场扫得一尘不染，落叶都没一片；布置会场的在主席台上铺红布，摆桌椅，调音响；插红旗的沿着操场四周插了一圈红旗，旗杆笔直，旗面在晨风中猎猎作响。

办公楼、宿舍全部被打扫得干干净净，窗明几净，连走廊的地板都拖得能照出人影来。

吃过早饭。今天早饭很丰盛，小米粥、白面馒头管饱，咸菜的种类也多了几种——腌萝卜、腌黄瓜、辣白菜，还有一碟腐乳。战士们吃得高兴，脸上都是笑。

不一会，师部和军部来了人，好几辆吉普车开进团部，下来一群首长，张团长和李参谋长迎上去，敬礼，握手，引着他们往主席台走。

全团在操场集合，各连各排整整齐齐地站成方队。王建新站在机关干部方队里，穿着崭新的四个兜军装，腰板挺得笔直。

首先举行升旗仪式。旗手扛着国旗，护旗手跟在两侧，迈着正步走到旗杆下。国歌奏响，国旗缓缓升起，全团官兵立正敬礼。王建新看着那面红旗在晨风中展开，一点一点地升到杆顶，心里热乎乎的。

领导讲话。师部的首长上了台，讲了一通话，大意是纪念建军节，回顾光荣历史，鼓励官兵继续奋斗。讲完了，张团长又讲了几句，然后是表彰环节。

“下面，宣读立功受奖人员名单。”李参谋长走到话筒前，展开一张纸。

团里三等功、二等功陆续被念到名字，上台领奖状。三等功十几个，二等功三个。每念到一个名字，下面响起一阵掌声。战士们上台，从首长手里接过奖状，敬礼，转身，台下又是一阵掌声。

“下面，宣读一等功。”李参谋长顿了顿，念道，“王建新！”

下面安静了一瞬，然后传来嗡嗡的讨论声。一等功，全团好几年没出过一等功了。官兵们交头接耳，目光在王建新身上扫来扫去。

王建新从队列里走出来，整了整军装，迈着正步走上主席台。

李参谋长开始通报王建新的事迹：“王建新同志，原达茂旗希拉脑亥生产队民兵巡边员。一九七零年七月十一日夜，发现十二名武装越境分子，英勇抗击，击毙九人，俘虏三人。随即赶赴红旗哨点救援，击毙七人，俘虏三人，救出受伤同志一人。又赶赴另一哨点，击毙九人。总计击毙二十五人，俘虏六人，救出同志一人。缴获步枪、手枪、电台、夜视仪等装备若干。”

When I was eating in the cafeteria at noon, I met many acquaintances.Captain Zhou from the Health Team, Director Liu from the Political Department, Director Wang from the Logistics Department, and several officers from other departments whom he had met in the past few days, all came over with rice bowls to greet him and congratulate him.

Vice leader Wang was the most lively. He came over from another table with a rice bowl and slapped Wang Jianxin on the shoulder so hard that he almost fell down.Deputy Commander Wang's loud voice buzzed in the cafeteria: "Do a good job! Go to school, study hard, and call me if you need anything. Remember, our group is your natal family!"

Wang Jianxin wonders if Captain Wang's hand hurts?He quickly stood upright and saluted: "Yes, Chief!"

Deputy Captain Wang nodded with satisfaction and left with the rice bowl.Wang Jianxin could see Commander Wang's hand moving back and forth. It must be quite painful, right?After all, his body can carry bullets.

Time flies.Wang Jianxin studied non-stop, reading Western medicine books during the day, Russian medical materials at night, and practicing in space in the middle of the night.Now he has learned almost everything about the theory of Western medicine - anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, diagnosis, and has studied every subject.He has a good brain. He can remember something after reading it once and understand it quickly.As long as he goes to school to learn practical skills, he will make rapid progress, and it won't take long for him to reach great success in Western medicine.

In the evening, I simply had something to eat in the cafeteria and then returned to the dormitory early to continue studying.Lately in the middle of the night he often goes to the space to improve the food.Although the troops can eat enough, including coarse grains, and can eat meat once or twice a month, the officers and soldiers still work very hard. They train a lot every day, consume a lot of food, and cannot keep up with their nutrition.

In the space, in addition to improving the food - stewed mutton, fried steak, scrambled eggs, various caviar, seafood, truffles, and eat them in different ways.White flour steamed buns and rice are enough - the most annoying thing is milking the cows and making dairy products, which is very time-consuming. Fortunately, the time ratio of space has changed.He is still practicing hard.The fourth level of Qi Refining is so awesome. What would it be like if it reached the fifth or sixth level?He didn't dare to think about it, but he felt itchy in his heart.Sitting cross-legged by the river every day, the spiritual energy circulates in the body, and the liquid spiritual power flows slowly in the Dantian, like a pool of spring water.There is still a long way to go from the fourth level to the fifth level of Qi refining, but he is not in a hurry and takes his time.

The next day, August 1st, was Army Day.

The whole group got up early.It's not bright yet, but the playground is already bustling.Those who arranged the venue were decorated, those who were putting up red flags were putting up red flags, and the soldiers were running in and out, so busy that their feet did not touch the ground.The whole group was busy on the training ground - the cleaners kept the playground spotless, with not a single fallen leaf; the organizers spread red cloth on the rostrum, set up tables and chairs, and adjusted the sound; the ones who planted red flags planted a circle of red flags along the perimeter of the playground. The flagpole was straight, and the flags sounded in the morning breeze.

The office buildings and dormitories have all been cleaned, the windows are bright and clean, and even the floors in the corridors have been mopped so that people can be seen.

Had breakfast.Today's breakfast was very rich, with millet porridge, white flour steamed buns, and more types of pickles - pickled radish, pickled cucumber, spicy cabbage, and a plate of fermented bean curd.The soldiers ate happily with smiles on their faces.

After a while, people from the division headquarters and the military headquarters arrived. Several jeeps drove into the regiment headquarters, and a group of leaders came down. Captain Zhang and Chief of Staff Li greeted them, saluted, shook hands, and led them to the rostrum.

The whole regiment gathered on the playground, and each company and row stood neatly in a square formation.Wang Jianxin stood in the formation of government officials, wearing a brand-new four-pocket military uniform, with his back straight.

First, a flag-raising ceremony was held.The flag bearer carried the national flag, and the flag guards followed on both sides, walking to the foot of the flagpole in goose-step.The national anthem played, the national flag slowly rose, and the entire regiment stood at attention and saluted.Wang Jianxin felt warm in his heart as he watched the red flag unfurling in the morning breeze and rising to the top of the pole little by little.

Leaders speak.The head of the division came on stage and gave a speech, which was to commemorate Army Day, review the glorious history, and encourage officers and soldiers to continue their struggle.After finishing speaking, Captain Zhang said a few more words, and then came the commendation session.

"Next, read out the list of recipients of meritorious service." Chief of Staff Li walked to the microphone and unfolded a piece of paper.

The names of the third-class and second-class merit performers in the regiment were read out one after another, and they came to the stage to receive their certificates.There are a dozen third-class merit officers and three second-class merit officers.Every time a name was read, there was a burst of applause.The soldiers came onto the stage, took the certificate from the leader, saluted, turned around, and there was another burst of applause from the audience.

"Next, read out the first-class merit." Chief of Staff Li paused and read, "Wang Jianxin!"

It was quiet for a moment, and then there was a buzz of discussion.First-class merit. The whole group has not received first-class merit for several years.The officers and soldiers whispered to each other and glanced at Wang Jianxin.

Wang Jianxin walked out of the queue, straightened his military uniform, and walked up to the podium with goose steps.

Chief of Staff Li began to report Wang Jianxin's deeds: "Comrade Wang Jianxin was a former militia patrolman of the Shilanao Production Team in Damao Banner. On the night of July 11, 1970, twelve armed cross-border elements were discovered, and he fought bravely, killing nine and capturing three. He immediately rushed toWent to the Red Flag Post for rescue, killed seven people, captured three, and rescued one injured comrade.We also rushed to another post, killed a total of 25 people, captured six people, and rescued several rifles, pistols, radios, and night vision equipment."
